item.title: Do Good Donuts: Sweet treats aid local children's charities
item.description: Do Good Donuts, founded by Rosevelt Rawls, donates 40% of its profits to charities that aid children and offers a variety of fresh, customizable donuts in Downtown Gilbert.

item.title: Proactive car care: The secret to being a better car owner
item.description: Shahe Koulloukian, owner of Mazvo Auto Car Care Center, emphasizes the importance of car maintenance and advises car owners to be proactive in checking essential fluids and battery conditions, while also encouraging them to take an active role in their vehicle's upkeep and read the owner's manual for detailed maintenance guidance.

item.title: Explore aviation at Chandler Airport Day event
item.description: Chandler Municipal Airport is hosting Airport Day this Saturday, inviting the community to explore aviation and learn about the airport's history and operations, featuring vintage aircraft, flight schools, and activities for kids.

item.title: GCU spirit triumphs: Cheer, dance, and pep band victories
item.description: Grand Canyon University's spirit program won five national titles at the UDA/UCA nationals in Orlando, Florida, showcasing the talents of its cheer team, dance team and pep band.

item.title: Start the new year right: Expert tips for financial well-being
item.description: Financial expert Jason Brown encourages people to start the new year with a realistic look at their finances, focusing on long-term goals and consistency, rather than short-term resolutions, to build sustainable wealth.

item.title: 'New year, new you' must-haves for a healthy 2026
item.description: Lifestyle expert, Brooke Youngs shares her top "New Year, New You" essentials, including Tejava Unsweetened Tea, Mary's Gone Crackers, and Long Weekend instant soups, all of which are healthy, delicious, and perfect for the whole family.

item.title: Dallas Cowboys cheerleader turned author releases debut novel
item.description: Marina Evans, a former Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader and Phoenix-based author, is celebrating the release of her debut novel, The Cheerleader, with a book signing at The Poisoned Pen Bookstore in Old Town Scottsdale.

item.title: Manda's Macs Bakery charms with macarons and homemade ice cream
item.description: Amanda Newland, owner of Manda's Macs Bakery, creates French macarons and homemade ice cream using local and organic ingredients, emphasizing high-quality ingredients and sustainability in her baking processes.

item.title: Pantone's 2026 color: 'Cloud Dancer' soft white for calm
item.description: Pantone named "Cloud Dancer" as its 2026 Color of the Year, a soft white intended to bring calm and clarity into homes. The color "Cloud Dancer" is described as a soft, airy white that serves as a canvas for various home decor styles.
